sun.tools.jconsole

类 BorderedComponent.LabeledBorder

  • java.lang.Object
    • javax.swing.border.AbstractBorder
      • javax.swing.border.TitledBorder
        • sun.tools.jconsole.BorderedComponent.LabeledBorder
  • 所有已实现的接口:
    Serializable, Border
    封闭类:
    BorderedComponent

    protected static class BorderedComponent.LabeledBorder
extends TitledBorder
    A subclass of TitledBorder which implements an arbitrary border with the addition of a JComponent (JLabel, JPanel, etc) in the default position.

    If the border property value is not specified in the constructor or by invoking the appropriate set method, the property value will be defined by the current look and feel, using the following property name in the Defaults Table:

    • "TitledBorder.border"
